import grimp,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
g=grimp.build_graph('app','adapters','orchestration','engines','contracts','domain',include_external_packages=False,exclude_type_checking_imports=False,cache_dir=None)
nodes=sorted(g.modules)
roots=['app','adapters','orchestration','engines','contracts','domain']
edges={r:sorted({n.split('.')[0] for m in nodes if m.split('.')[0]==r for n in g.find_modules_directly_imported_by(m) if n.split('.')[0]!=r}) for r in roots}
result={'roots':roots,'modules':nodes,'root_edges':edges,'namespace_verified':'adapters.sqlite_store' in nodes and 'adapters.save_slots' in nodes}
assert result['namespace_verified']
Path(sys.argv[1]).write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps(result))

import grimp,json
g=grimp.build_graph('app','adapters','orchestration','engines','contracts','domain',cache_dir=None)
c=g.find_shortest_chain(importer='domain.value',imported='app.entry')
assert c==('domain.value','contracts.port','app.entry'),c
assert 'adapters.port' in g.modules
print(json.dumps({'chain':c,'namespace_child_present':True}))

import coverage,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
c=coverage.Coverage(config_file=sys.argv[1]);c.load()
a=json.loads(Path(sys.argv[2]).read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
out={m['path']:c.analysis2(str(Path(sys.argv[3])/m['path']))[1] for m in a['public_engine_methods']}
assert c.get_data().has_arcs()
Path(sys.argv[4]).write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({'branch_data':c.get_data().has_arcs(),'measured_files':sorted(c.get_data().measured_files()),'contexts':sorted(c.get_data().measured_contexts())}))

import coverage,json,sys
c=coverage.Coverage(config_file=sys.argv[1],data_file=sys.argv[2])
c.start()
try:
    trace=sys.gettrace();owner=getattr(trace,"__self__",trace)
    assert owner.__class__.__module__=="coverage.pytracer" and owner.__class__.__name__=="PyTracer"
    print(json.dumps({"core_config":c.get_option("run:core"),"active_trace_class":owner.__class__.__module__+"."+owner.__class__.__name__,"branch":c.get_option("run:branch"),"dynamic_context":c.get_option("run:dynamic_context")}))
finally:c.stop()
